title.narrative: Unlocking Sustainable Investments at Scale towards Adaptation (USISA) Partnership with Nordic Development Fund

description.narrative:
With the overall aim of mobilising private capital to increase the resilience of emerging markets and developing economies to climate impacts, the partnership with the Nordic Development Fund will contribute by providing catalytic financing for climate adaptation projects in Sub-Saharan Africa. This will help mobilise additional climate finance, de-risk investments, and demonstrate commercial viability in the adaptation space, while incentivising fund managers to deploy their expertise to address financing needs related to climate adaptation. In doing so, the partnership will expand the range of investment vehicles available to private sector investors.
This will be achieved by:
- Identifying experienced fund managers and investment partners through the Investment Collaboration Alliance for climate adaptation projects in Sub-Saharan Africa, thereby mobilising capital and supporting countries and vulnerable populations in becoming more resilient and adapting to the adverse effects of climate change. - Providing concessional and catalytic financing to mobilise additional climate finance for climate adaptation in Sub-Saharan Africa, thereby expanding the range of investment vehicles available to private sector investors
